The net ATP from substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 from glucose and 3 from glycogen, since glycogen-derived glucose-6-phosphate bypasses the hexokinase ATP-consuming step. Neither of the two options in the note (3 from glucose and 4 from glycogen; 3 from glucose and 2 from glycogen) is correct.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
